title: GNOMON
title_controls: Move: {move}     Jump: Space     Run: Shift     Sun: {back} / {fwd} or mouse wheel
tip_start: The sun obeys you: hold {back} to turn it back, {fwd} to move it forward.
tip_shadow: Black stones cast solid shadows. Bring the sun back towards dawn: the shadow of the wall stretches to the next island.
tip_hub: The great gnomon awaits three seals: dawn, zenith and dusk.
tip_hanging: A shadow lies at the height of its stone's foot. Climb the step to reach the floating one.
tip_cloud: Under a cloud, no shadow holds. Cross between two clouds.
tip_ferry: The hanging monolith casts a shadow that travels with the sun. Stay on it while the hour turns.
tip_fall: The void brings you back to the last island you visited.
tip_beam: The seal is yours. The column of light takes you back to the Dial.
tip_final: The great gnomon stands. At noon, its shadow leads to the Observatory.
pause_stats: {shards} shards out of {total}     {seals} seals out of 3     {time}
end_text: The three seals are set and the great dial marks the hours again.
end_hint: Click to go back to the title screen
